requirements_summary: Opaline is evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for a regulated payments workload. Primary network model desired: AWS PrivateLink from their VPCs into Redwood endpoints deployed in their account or a dedicated VPC peered via Transit Gateway. Must support: 1) IP allowlist binding (static egress to customer's NAT + SIEM), 2) strict egress controls — only HTTPS to specific Redwood IP ranges and Splunk ingest, 3) explicit firewall rule templates (security group + NACL examples) and change window guidance, 4) customer-managed KMS (AWS CMK) for model cache and logs encryption, 5) audit log streaming (raw request/response metadata) to customer's S3 and Splunk with retention controls, 6) data residency pinned to us-east-1 for initial rollout. Latency target: p50 < 120ms for chat, troughput target: 40 reqs/s sustained with burst to 200. High availability requirement across AZs and clear fallback policy (regional fallback only, no cross-region without prior approval).
